definitions.explanation: The warmest season of the year.

examples.japanese: {夏休|なつやす}みに{海|うみ}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'll go to the beach during summer vacation.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{夏|なつ}はとても{暑|あつ}かった。
{夏|なつ}になると{毎日|まいにち}{暑|あつ}くて、{外|そと}に{出|で}たくなくなる。
examples.english: When summer comes, it's hot every day and I don't want to go outside.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}の{夏|なつ}は{家族|かぞく}で{海|うみ}に{行|い}って、{毎日|まいにち}{泳|およ}いだり{遊|あそ}んだりしてとても{楽|たの}しかった。
examples.english: Last summer I went to the beach with my family, and we had a great time swimming and playing every day.

notes:
{夏|なつ} is summer, the hottest season in Japan (June-August).

JAPANESE SEASONS:
- {春|はる}: spring
- {夏|なつ}: summer
- {秋|あき}: autumn/fall
- {冬|ふゆ}: winter

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {夏休|なつやす}み: summer vacation
- {真夏|まなつ}: midsummer
- {夏祭|なつまつ}り: summer festival
- {夏服|なつふく}: summer clothes
- {夏|なつ}バテ: summer fatigue

CULTURAL NOTES:
- お{盆|ぼん}: Obon festival (mid-August)
- {花火|はなび}{大会|たいかい}: fireworks festivals
- {甲子園|こうしえん}: high school baseball championship

SEASONAL GREETING:
{暑中|しょちゅう}お{見舞|みま}い{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます: summer greeting card phrase
